episode_id: Upstream changed something about its branches and my checkout is lost. Sort it out. Track upstream's new branch and merge it into my own commits./seed-2-branch_renamed-19837

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (branch_renamed seed 1 resolves to 'merge', which accepts ['merge']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'retrack', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'merge' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.intent: retrack the current branch onto upstream's renamed branch and merge it into the local commits

postconditions.description: the current branch now tracks the new upstream branch
postconditions.name: tracks_new_upstream

postconditions.description: the new upstream branch is available as a remote-tracking ref
postconditions.name: target_remote_branch_available

postconditions.description: the new upstream branch is an ancestor of HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_merged

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit preserving local commits and integrating upstream
postconditions.name: head_is_merge_commit

postconditions.description: the merge left no staged, unstaged or untracked files
postconditions.name: worktree_clean_after

preconditions.description: the current directory is a Git work tree
preconditions.name: inside_work_tree

preconditions.description: the new upstream branch is already available as a remote-tracking ref
preconditions.name: target_remote_branch_exists

preconditions.description: the new upstream branch is the remote's default branch
preconditions.name: target_is_remote_default

preconditions.description: there are no staged, unstaged or untracked changes before merging
preconditions.name: worktree_clean_before

preconditions.description: the current branch is configured to track a different branch on the upstream remote
preconditions.name: tracks_other_branch_on_remote
preconditions.probe:
current_branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD) || exit 1
tracked_remote=$(git config --get "branch.$current_branch.remote") || exit 1
tracked_merge=$(git config --get "branch.$current_branch.merge") || exit 1
test "$tracked_remote" = "{upstream_remote}"
test "$tracked_merge" != "refs/heads/{upstream_branch}"

preconditions.description: both the local branch and the new upstream branch have unique commits
preconditions.name: diverged_from_target

preconditions.description: the local and upstream sides do not change the same paths relative to their merge base
preconditions.name: no_conflicting_changed_paths
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) || exit 1
! comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) | grep -q .
